cards.h: Hormel named the date of its CEO handoff 14 months in advance, dissolved the search committee, and hit the date.
cards.s: A CPG company runs a pre-announced 15-month interim CEO term and installs the permanent successor on the stated date.

cards.h: Hershey grew North America confectionery sales 4.2 percent on roughly 14 points of price. The rest is volume going the other way.
cards.s: A confectioner posts a beat built on price while volumes fall, and raises brand spending.

cards.h: Sysco grew sales 4.7 percent last quarter. A specialty distributor a fraction of its size grew 12.9 percent over almost exactly the same weeks.
cards.s: A specialty distributor grows 12.9 percent on penetration and case volume over the same weeks Sysco grew 4.7 percent.

cards.h: P&G put the chairman and CEO titles back in one pair of hands and retired the executive who had held them separately.
cards.s: A CPG board recombines chairman and CEO as the executive chairman retires.

cards.h: S&P 500 boards added directors at the slowest rate in a decade, and 37 percent of the ones they added were CEOs.
cards.s: Board refreshment slows to a decade low as CEOs take 37 percent of new S&P 500 seats.

cards.h: Global employee engagement fell to 20 percent. Manager engagement fell further, from 31 percent in 2022 to 22 percent in 2025.
cards.s: Global engagement falls to 20 percent, with the steepest decline among managers.

cards.h: Heineken cut about 3,000 positions in six months, half of a two-year target, and beat profit expectations
cards.s: A global brewer removes 3,000 roles in six months, half its two-year target, while beating profit expectations.

cards.h: Productivity rose 1.4 percent. Labor's share of output fell to 52.9 percent, the lowest reading since the series began in 1947
cards.s: Labor's share of output hits a 79-year low as productivity rises.

cards.h: The facility tied to 9,481 illnesses last saw an FDA inspector in 2019. The visit before that came during a 2013 outbreak
cards.s: The facility at the center of a 9,481-case outbreak went seven years without an FDA inspection, against a mandate the agency meets at 5 percent.

cards.h: Six days after recombining its chairman and chief executive roles, P&G agreed to buy Thorne for $3.8 billion in cash
cards.s: P&G buys a supplements platform from L Catterton for $3.8 billion days after consolidating its chair.

cards.h: B&G Foods announced its next chief executive five days before it could name him. He was already on the board
cards.s: A packaged-food company names a sitting board member and former retail technology officer as CEO.

cards.h: Repeat public-company chief executives took 34 percent of new S&P 500 appointments in the first half, against 22 percent a year earlier
cards.s: One in three new S&P 500 CEOs has run a public company before, up from one in five.

cards.h: Target created a chief AI officer and hired the job out of Lowe's. Walmart does not have the title
cards.s: A mass retailer creates its first chief AI officer role and fills it from home-improvement retail.

cards.h: A reporter requested his own data from McDonald's and received 515 pages. The file scored his attrition risk at zero
cards.s: A data access request returns a 515-page loyalty file with purchase predictions and an attrition score.

cards.h: Before Google, the web had no dominant search engine and Yahoo's directory was assembled by hand
cards.s: A retrospective on the mid-1990s web, when a dozen search engines competed and Yahoo's directory was built by hand.

cards.h: Divers recovered Bronze Age storage vessels from an Italian lake with the grain still inside them
cards.s: Bronze Age storage jars recovered from an Italian lake still hold preserved spelt.
